Question ID: SPEECH_U05_L05_GuidedPractice_Q01

MLA Standard: MLA.SPEECH.COM.07

Which sentence has the most constructive audience impact?

answer.text: A. Use a word that sounds harsh for the audience

feedback.text: This choice does not fit the audience or purpose clearly enough. Check how word meaning or digital structure affects the listener.

answer.text: B. Students should use group work time more purposefully

feedback.text: Correct. This choice supports clear, audience-aware communication through precise word meaning or coherent digital presentation design.

answer.text: C. Ignore the feeling a word creates

feedback.text: This choice reflects a misconception. Recheck tone, word meaning, slide organization, or presentation coherence.

answer.text: D. Use a word with the wrong direct meaning

feedback.text: This choice weakens the presentation because it ignores how the audience understands the message.
